verdicts.reason: Both share the same breaks: the body copy sits on top of the teal circle at the far left, the circle is split off from the can it should frame, the body copy comes before the headline in reading order, the GLACIER wordmark sits below the headline, and the CTA and chips are crammed together edge to edge. A spreads these pieces across the width with large dead gaps around a tiny floating can. B groups the can, headline and buttons more tightly but leaves an empty band at the right, so it is only marginally better.
